summary: A web app with an Admin Panel and customer-facing Website. Admin-to-web sync, shop status toggling, database integrity, and error handling are being actively built.
architectural_notes: Global State logic required between Admin Panel and Website for real-time sync
All admin writes must use high-priority database write commands to avoid revert bugs
known_issues: 'Reverting to Open' bug: shop status reverts after admin toggle due to low-priority writes

existing_features.title: Fix the 'Reverting to Open' bug in shop status toggling: when the admin toggles shop open/closed status, the backend must persist the new status with an authoritative write (no optimistic-only update). The toggle must await backend confirmation before treating the update as complete. If the write succeeds, immediately invalidate and refetch the shop status query on both the admin panel and the website so the customer-facing view reflects the change without stale data.

Ensure all admin write actions — including adding/editing product stock, updating order status, and submitting recharge orders — await backend confirmation before marking the operation as successful. Remove any fire-and-forget or optimistic-only patterns that can silently fail. Each mutation in useQueries.ts must properly await the actor call result and propagate errors to the calling component.

Replace all fake or silent loading states on admin mutations with real error feedback. When any admin write operation (shop status toggle, stock update, order status change, recharge submission) fails, display a clear, visible error message (e.g., a toast notification or inline error text) stating what failed. Do not show a spinner or 'Updating…' animation that never resolves or never reports the actual failure to the user.

Implement a global shop status polling or query invalidation strategy on the customer-facing website so that the shop open/closed state stays in sync with the backend. The website should refetch shop status at a short interval (e.g., every 30 seconds) and also refetch immediately on window focus, so customers always see the current status without a full page reload.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin-to-Web Full System Sync: instant shop status updates on website when toggled in admin
Database integrity: high-priority write commands for all admin actions (stock, status, recharge) to prevent 'Reverting to Open' bug
Error handling: show clear error message on database update failure instead of fake 'Updating' animation
